$comment: GENERATED by `pnpm ui:docs` from src/ui/features.ts: the screens `pxsig dashboard check` renders. Do not edit.

features.title: Top bar
features.purpose: The report's title (its label, else the project name) with the versions on hover, the section links with their counts, and the controls pinned at the end: start review, project, modes, connection with whether this page can approve (Read only / Can approve, the command for a dashboard link on hover), last check, theme, review status.

states.loading: The page shows a loading line until the first data arrives.
states.error: The page shows the load error instead of the dashboard.
states.offline: The connection badge reads Offline; the review button is hidden.
states.static: The connection badge reads Static report · Read only; nothing that writes is shown.
states.readOnly: Live · Read only: this page holds no dashboard link; the review buttons are disabled.
states.canApprove: Live · Can approve: this page opened the dashboard link.

features.title: Theme toggle
features.purpose: Switches between the light and dark theme; the choice is remembered per viewer.

features.title: Coverage banner
features.purpose: Shown on every section while the coverage ledger has errors, or entries wait for a first approval: the headline, setup problems, a link to Coverage and the safe repair. On the Overview the errors card carries the errors instead, so they are not shown twice.

states.static: No repair button: a static report cannot write.

features.title: Latest check in numbers
features.purpose: Checked, passed, changed, flaky, new accessibility violations and duration of the last check; the changed, flaky and accessibility figures open what they count.

states.empty: Without a check: the command that runs one.

features.title: Open Items
features.purpose: What needs a decision, one row per kind (changed, new, rejected, render errors, coverage errors, accessibility, flaky), each with its action.

states.empty: A line saying nothing is open; the rows stay, at zero.

features.title: Overview columns
features.purpose: Below the counts, two equal columns: open items, then stale entries by component, on the left; errors (only while there are any), then changed entries per run, on the right. One column, left then right, when the page is narrow.

features.title: Errors
features.purpose: The coverage banner's details and the safe repair first (only while there is something to repair or approve), then the render errors of the last check and coverage errors (components, setup), one row each, opening the render errors list or Coverage on that component. Shown only while there are errors.

states.static: No repair button: a static report cannot write.

features.title: Changed Entries per Run
features.purpose: The Runs chart of changed entries per recorded run, as a line, in the right column.

states.empty: Without recorded runs the chart is not shown.

features.title: Stale Entries by Component
features.purpose: A heatmap of the components with stale verdicts: one tile per component, coloured by its share of stale entries in five steps, with the count on the tile, highest share first. The Overview shows the first 12, Coverage all of them.

states.empty: No stale entries: a line saying so.

features.title: Review filters
features.purpose: Search by entry id, filter by result and mode, sort, and group by component; the count of shown entries sits on the same line.

states.empty: Without a check: the command that runs one.

features.title: Story cards
features.purpose: One card per entry: thumbnail, verdict, mode and state tags, accessibility and coverage flags, metrics; a coloured edge per verdict. Grouped by component, paged.

states.empty: A line saying no entry matches.

features.title: Coverage ledger
features.purpose: Whether every story is registered, rendered, checked and current, per component, with counts that filter the table, stale entries by component as a heatmap, and the entries of a chosen component.

states.empty: Without integrity data: the commands that produce it.

features.title: Accessibility rules
features.purpose: axe violations grouped by rule, new ones first, with impact, entries, nodes and how many are accepted; a review session for the new ones.

states.empty: Without a check, or with accessibility scans off: what to run.

features.title: Runs
features.purpose: The last check's timing, then changed entries and engine time per run as lines, and every recorded run as a table.

states.empty: Without a history file: where it is written.

features.title: Diagnostics
features.purpose: Research data, when a run wrote it: detection rate per scenario suite, scenario results with their renders, gate calibration and engine performance.

states.empty: Each part says which tool writes its data; the section is hidden when there is none.

features.title: Help
features.purpose: First, how approving works: the dashboard link, its timing, and the connection and approval badges. Then what each section, card icon, status, React alert, text label, coverage code, inspector region and key means, beside a drawing of where it appears, and which pxsig, engine and UI contract versions drew the page.

features.title: React Compiler
features.purpose: The React Compiler's verdict on the changed component and hook files, at the merge base and now: alerts first (newly skipped, new and skipped, a new reason, a new finding), every function analysed on demand, and one function's diagnostics, base and entries in a side panel. The title names the compiler that ran: the project's babel-plugin-react-compiler, or the built-in one (oxc, experimental). Alerts only: nothing here fails a check or asks for a decision.

states.loading: Analysing: a progress row with Skip; the table keeps the last results, busy.
states.empty: No results yet, with Analyse; no alerts, or no changed files, in the table.
states.error: The last analysis failed: what happened, and that checks are not affected.
states.static: No Analyse: a static report cannot run anything.
states.readOnly: Analyse and Skip are disabled: they need the dashboard link.
states.canApprove: Analyse and Skip work (they decide nothing).

features.title: React renders
features.purpose: React's commits and renders per entry, counted while pxsig rendered it: the entries React was still committing at capture first, every entry measured on demand, and one entry's counts, top components and counts before in a side panel. Measure renders runs a visual check of the entries in scope with counting on; Cancel stops it, and the entries rendered by then keep their new results.

states.loading: Measuring: a progress row with Cancel; Measure renders is disabled.
states.empty: No render counts yet: what Measure renders does.
states.static: No Measure renders and no Scope.
states.readOnly: Measure renders and Cancel are disabled: they need the dashboard link.
states.canApprove: Measure renders and Cancel work (a re-check, not a decision).

features.title: React in the inspector
features.purpose: In the header, beside the verdict: a Still rendering badge when React was still committing at capture (its title is the alert), a likely cause of a flaky entry; it never changes the verdict, the decision buttons or the review queue. In the side panel, after Accessibility: the entry's render counts, whether React had settled, its top components and the counts before, and the React Compiler alerts whose file reaches the entry, each opening Diagnostics › React on that function. Neither in the Storybook panel.

features.title: React progress strip
features.purpose: At the top of every section while the server analyses React files (with Skip) or measures renders (with Cancel), then how the run ended (the alerts in one line, skipped, failed, measured, cancelled) until dismissed. Never takes focus, blocks or counts down; only the start and the end are announced.

states.loading: A bar per run going on, with its count.
states.error: The analysis failed: what happened, and that checks are not affected.
states.offline: The rows stay as they were; Skip and Cancel are disabled.
states.readOnly: Skip and Cancel are disabled: they need the dashboard link.

features.title: React
features.purpose: In the Overview end column, after Errors: the compiler analysis and render counts in four figures (newly skipped, findings, compiled, still rendering), each opening the React view where it is listed. Alerts only, not blocking; shown only when there are results.

states.loading: While an analysis runs: the last figures, the file count under the description, busy.
states.empty: Not shown without results, or when React is off.

features.title: Inspector header
features.purpose: The entry id, its context and reasons, its verdict, its other modes and states, the position in the list, the review buttons and Close. Reject opens a row under the header for an optional reason (one line, at most 280 characters; `rejections.note.ask: false` rejects at once). A rejected entry's note gives its reason, the re-check command, Edit reason and Copy for an agent (one paragraph for an assistant); an entry checked again since its rejection shows Rejected earlier with Dismiss reason; a reason or packet the server did not keep says so.

states.readOnly: A note under the header gives the command for a dashboard link, with a copy button; Reject, Approve and Undo stay in place, disabled.

wait.text: Read only: approving needs the dashboard link. In a terminal, in the
Rejected. Reason: The label sits 4px lower than in the baseline

wait.name: Reject the violations with a reason

features.title: Image stage
features.purpose: Baseline and latest render side by side, as a swipe, onion skin, pixel difference or signature cells; pan, zoom, change regions and detail tiles; Originals shows the two images with no analysis drawn; built on the diff-viewer primitives.

states.loading: A loading line until both images decode.

wait.name: Show the original images without analysis

features.title: Inspector details
features.purpose: The pixel under the pointer, pixel changes and regions, signature metrics and images, accessibility violations and the files of the entry, with the Storybook link.

states.static: Pixel values need the server (a static report cannot read the images’ pixels).

features.title: Text labels
features.purpose: What changed in the entry's text, from its text record: in the header, beside the verdict, a badge (Copy, Copy, reflow, Text moved or Text restyled; none for a pixel change); in the side panel, after Pixel Changes, a Text section with the summary and each change as a sentence (a space shown as ␠) that shows its box on the stage, or why nothing was compared. Labels only: the gate, the verdict, the decision buttons and the review queue are the same without them.

states.empty: No text record in the baseline, another environment, a record not read, or no text changed: one muted line instead of the changes.

wait.text: No text record in the baseline. One is recorded at its next approval.

features.title: Masks
features.purpose: The masks on the entry's render (`data-volatile` elements, a story's `ignore`, `capture.ignore` of the project or workspace): in the side panel, after Pixel Changes, a Masks section with each mask's selector, where it came from, its reason and its share of the capture; when the masks changed since the baseline, Added, Removed, Grew, Count changed or Moved and both shares; masks no approval passes (over 50% of the capture together, on the story root, or a data-volatile with no reason or on a container) say so first, with the reasons and what to do about each, also when no mask was painted; such an entry is Blocked, with no Reject or Approve: the same line is in their place. A masks-only change (the masks failed the entry and no pixel differs) says so in the change stepper and Pixel Changes, and puts the Masks section first. In the header and on the entry's card, Masks changed and Large mask (all of the entry's masks together over 25% of the capture, a warning); Overview lists the entries with a large mask while there are any, and Review Stories filters them.

features.title: Review session
features.purpose: A queue (changed, new or accessibility) opened in the inspector with progress, then a summary of what was decided and what to run next.

states.empty: The summary when every entry is decided.

features.title: Report to pxsig
features.purpose: A gate report for a public issue on hydrotik/pxsig, when the gate got an entry wrong (the header's Report to pxsig button, beside Re-check). The dialog first re-renders the entry on this machine and says whether it still fails the gate, then previews exactly what is copied: one image (baseline, render and diff, cropped to the changed regions) or the image-free summary, and the text in the issue form's shape, with the story ID replaced by entry-1. It says the issue is public and cannot be fully removed. Copy text, Copy image (one PNG; Save image where the clipboard takes no images), Open issue (the prefilled form, in a new tab) and Cancel; nothing is copied until a copy button is pressed, and nothing is posted.

states.readOnly: Available: preparing a report decides nothing.
states.static: No Report to pxsig button: a static report has no server to re-render or compare.
states.loading: The re-render on this machine, then the report, each with a line saying so.
states.error: Why there is no report (no baseline, no render), or why the re-render failed.

wait.name: Baseline, render and diff side by side

click.name: No image: the changed regions and their average colors only

wait.text: No image. The text lists each changed region

wait.name: Baseline, render and diff side by side

features.title: Storybook panel
features.purpose: The inspector for one story inside the Storybook addon panel, without the page chrome; details open on demand.

states.empty: A line when the story has no checked entry.

features.title: Decision window
features.purpose: The small window the Storybook panel's Approve, Reject and Accept go through: the panel is a frame on another site, where the dashboard link is not sent, so the window (this server's own page) takes the decision from the panel, posts it and closes. Without the dashboard link it stays open and says to open the link first; a tab without it shows the same instruction under the inspector's header.

states.error: The decision was not recorded: the reason, or the instruction to open the dashboard link first.
states.empty: Opened on its own (no panel behind it): a line saying it has nothing to do.
